title: The continuous spectrum of bound states in expulsive potentials
summary: On the contrary to the common intuition, which suggests that a steep expulsive potential makes quantum states widely delocalized, we demonstrate that one- and two-dimensional (1D and 2D) Schroedinger equations, which include expulsive potentials that are steeper than the quadratic ones, give rise to normalizable eigenstates, which may be considered as a manifestation of effective self-trapping in the linear system.
